title: Pólya's conjecture for Neumann eigenvalues of annuli
summary: We prove strict Pólya inequalities for every positive Neumann eigenvalue of every Euclidean annulus. The proof preserves the exact Weyl area term through a radial action identity and combines variational bounds with uniform Bessel-phase and angular-sum estimates. Explicit polynomial positivity arguments and angular-layer comparisons cover the remaining finite spectral ranges.
